meta.title: Email & Lifecycle Marketing — Beyond Marketing
meta.description: Email and lifecycle marketing for Australian businesses. Klaviyo, Braze, ActiveCampaign, HubSpot and more — built to turn your list into predictable, compounding revenue.

hero.label: Email & Lifecycle
hero.sub: The money in your email program isn't going to find itself. We make it simpler, faster and genuinely profitable.

intro: You already know email is supposed to be your highest-returning channel. The data says $36 back for every dollar in. So why does it feel like yours is barely covering its own weight?
Here's what we see constantly: businesses sending campaigns that land in spam, automation that hasn't been touched since setup day, and a list full of people who stopped caring months ago.
Nobody flagged it. Nobody fixed it. Every month, that's revenue you didn't see and can't get back.
Most agencies will sell you on open rates and design. We don't. We care about one thing: whether your email program is making you money. If it isn't, we find out why, and we fix it.

guarantee.headline: Results guaranteed or we'll work for free.
guarantee.body: We don't do vanity metrics, because vanity metrics don't pay salaries. We'll beat your current email benchmarks within 90 days, or we'll work for free until we do.

benefits.heading: What we do
items: Lifecycle automation — welcome flows, post-purchase, win-back, browse and cart abandonment, all built around actual customer behaviour
Campaign strategy and execution — planned against your commercial calendar, not just whenever someone remembers
Platform setup and migration — Klaviyo, Braze, ActiveCampaign, HubSpot, Customer.io; whatever fits your stack
List health and deliverability — segmentation, suppression, sender reputation, so your emails actually land in the inbox
Revenue reporting — benchmarks that connect to revenue, not open rates padded to look good
Ongoing optimisation — tests, iterations, and improvements across flows and campaigns every month

faq.q: Which email platforms do you work with?
faq.a: Klaviyo, Braze, ActiveCampaign, HubSpot, Customer.io, Mailchimp and more. We'll recommend the right platform for your stage and budget if you're not locked in yet.

faq.q: Do you only work with ecommerce brands?
faq.a: No. Email works for ecommerce, SaaS, B2B and service businesses. The flows and campaigns look different, but the principle is the same: turn the people who've heard of you into people who buy from you, and keep them buying.

Strategy, campaign execution, flow management and reporting. The exact scope depends on your program — some clients need ongoing campaign support, others need us to build and then hand over. We scope it around what will make the biggest difference.

faq.q: How long before we see results?
faq.a: Technical fixes and flow improvements can show movement within weeks. Compounding results from a well-run program build over months. We set clear targets up front so you know what we're working toward.
Access to your email platform, and ideally your ecommerce or CRM data. Read-only is fine for the audit phase. We'll tell you exactly what we need before we start.
